name: Ore ga Aishita Hitozuma ~Emiko~
original_name: 俺が愛した人妻 ～恵美子～
source:
It was a coincidence that I met Emiko.
Touched by her kindness, I fell in love.
But the very next moment, I noticed the ring on her finger and my heart dropped.
Not giving up, I continued to interact with her.
How will our relationship change and develop?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=948540]Getchu[/url]]
